what_changed_between_runs: budget default 2000 -> 4000 (the only retrieval knob touched; same glance binary)
steering rewritten: AGENTS.md memory-first policy (honest miss, freshness quoting, code only on explicit request); MEMORY.md aligned
every memory entry now carries its date (dated headings or '*(as of YYYY-MM-DD)*' stamps)
vault distilled: decisions.md back to <=150 lines, one stale entry dropped, one eval lesson added

accuracy.note: run2 semantic = 1.0 on all 11 scored questions; lexical 1.0 on 10/11 (Q10 0.67, rescued by --semantic)

updates.doctor_after_edits_note: false in both runs, both explained: '../AGENTS.md' dangles only in the scratch copy, and the suite's own inserts push decisions.md past 150 lines — the linter catching the protocol violation

hit_miss_signal.note: NEGATIVE RESULT: top-score magnitude separates hit from miss in NEITHER tier (semantic: answered mean 1.63 vs no-answer 1.65; lexical: 12.96 vs 8.16, overlapping). A numeric 'weak bundle' floor won't work as-is; the honest-miss rule must stay content-based (check the returned text literally answers), as shipped in AGENTS.md. A future signal needs calibration (score distribution vault-relative) or answer-presence verification.

verdict: run2 reaches accuracy 1.0 (semantic; lexical 0.97) at ~32-34% tokens saved vs no-glance baseline and ~86% saved on writes; the 2000-budget truncation failures are gone; steering now guarantees dates quoted and honest misses
